judged_text: BaseCalendarService.createEvent filters the credential's discovered calendars down to those matching destinationCalendar[0].externalId, so when the CalDAV service belongs to any destination other than the first the filter matches nothing and no event is created anywhere. Collective bookings with a CalDAV host whose destination is not first produce zero events for that host while CalendarManager still returns success and a reference row is written with the uid, creating a phantom reference that later updates and deletes will fail against.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` (`BaseCalendarService.createEvent`), the diff introduces `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then filters discovered CalDAV calendars with `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : true`. Since `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` is changed in this PR to an array and collective/team flows now push multiple destination calendars (`handleNewBooking.ts` pushes team members’ destination calendars), any non-first destination calendar’s `externalId` will be ignored by this filter. As a result, when creating an event for a credential associated with a later destination calendar, the filter can yield an empty list and `Promise.all([])` will do nothing (no event created) without necessarily throwing, matching the reported “zero events for that host” behavior.
